book-agatha-christie-murder-on-the-orien.Dr. Constantine: A doctor travelling on the train who examines the victim. The physical evidence proves more contradictory than his clinical experience would lead him to expect.
book-agatha-christie-murder-on-the-orien.Mary Debenham: An English governess whose composure interests Poirot almost as much as her account of the journey. She chooses each answer carefully.
book-agatha-christie-murder-on-the-orien.Colonel Arbuthnot: A British officer accustomed to having his word accepted. His certainty about a fellow passenger invites Poirot to ask how well they know each other.
book-agatha-christie-murder-on-the-orien.Hector MacQueen: Ratchett's American secretary handles correspondence for an employer he scarcely admires. His account gives Poirot a way into the dead man's private affairs.
book-agatha-christie-murder-on-the-orien.Hildegarde Schmidt: A German lady's maid questioned about a late-night errand. Long service has taught her to notice small disruptions without presuming to discuss them.

book-alice-walker-the-color-purple.Celie: A Black girl in rural Georgia finds in letters a place to speak freely. Sewing and female friendship gradually give that private voice a public life.
book-alice-walker-the-color-purple.Nettie: Celie's sister values education and refuses to surrender their bond. Her letters describe a distant life while always addressing the person she misses.
book-alice-walker-the-color-purple.Shug Avery: A blues singer whose refusal to live by respectable rules captivates Celie. Onstage command coexists with unexpected tenderness in private.
book-alice-walker-the-color-purple.Albert: Celie's husband, whom she calls Mister, expects obedience as the natural order at home. Shug's presence exposes the limits of his authority.
book-alice-walker-the-color-purple.Sofia: Harpo's strong-willed partner knows exactly what it costs to defend herself. Other people's demand for deference presents a danger far beyond the household.
book-alice-walker-the-color-purple.Harpo: Mister's son loves Sofia and receives disastrous advice about how a husband should behave. He has to learn what sort of home he wants.

book-stephanie-garber-once-upon-a-broken.Evangeline Fox: A curiosity-shop owner's daughter who believes in true love strongly enough to bargain with a Fate. She has a harder time spotting the loopholes.
book-stephanie-garber-once-upon-a-broken.Jacks: The Prince of Hearts has a taste for apples and a reputation for deadly kisses. He offers help on terms that become clearer after the bargain.
book-stephanie-garber-once-upon-a-broken.Apollo Acadian: A northern prince whose good looks and position make him the centre of a royal marriage spectacle. His attention changes Evangeline's prospects overnight.
book-stephanie-garber-once-upon-a-broken.Marisol Tourmaline: Evangeline's stepsister is keenly aware of how society judges a girl whose wedding has gone awry. She would dearly like a different story told about her.
book-stephanie-garber-once-upon-a-broken.Luc Navarro: The young man Evangeline loves at the opening of the story. His engagement to her stepsister sends her looking for a supernatural explanation.

book-john-steinbeck-east-of-eden.Adam Trask: A California rancher wants to build a good life for his twin sons. His habit of idealizing the people he loves makes some truths especially hard to see.
book-john-steinbeck-east-of-eden.Caleb Trask: One of Adam's twins sees the less flattering side of people's motives, including his own. He wants his father's love without knowing how to ask for it.
book-john-steinbeck-east-of-eden.Aron Trask: Cal's twin finds comfort in ideal images of purity and goodness. He depends on others to leave those images undisturbed.
book-john-steinbeck-east-of-eden.Cathy Ames: A woman with a keen eye for other people's vulnerabilities uses charm and calculated helplessness to gain control over her circumstances.
book-john-steinbeck-east-of-eden.Lee: The Trasks' Chinese American housekeeper knows the family well enough to challenge it. A question about a single word in Genesis becomes his way into an argument about choice.
book-john-steinbeck-east-of-eden.Samuel Hamilton: An Irish-born rancher and inventor whose ingenuity seldom results in wealth. His conversation gives Adam companionship and, when needed, an unwelcome demand for honesty.
book-john-steinbeck-east-of-eden.Abra Bacon: A young woman loved by the Trask boys grows uneasy with being idealized. She would rather risk being known entire than be preserved as somebody's idea of a good girl.

book-ana-huang-twisted-lies.Stella Alonso: A fashion influencer who projects serenity to an enormous audience. Away from the camera, anxiety and financial uncertainty make her carefully styled life harder to sustain.
book-ana-huang-twisted-lies.Christian Harper: A security-company owner who can arrange almost anything, including a convincing fake relationship. Around Stella, vigilance and possessiveness become difficult to separate.
book-ana-huang-twisted-lies.Jules Ambrose: A sharp-tongued aspiring lawyer who enjoys verbal combat with Josh. She has worked hard to build a future her past could still put in jeopardy.
book-ana-huang-twisted-lies.Maura: The former nanny who helped raise Stella now lives in care. Their visits preserve a family bond that means more to Stella than any public display of success.

book-ali-hazelwood-love-theoretically.Elsie Hannaway: An underpaid theoretical physicist who moonlights as a fake girlfriend. She can become almost anyone a client wants, which complicates stating her own ambitions.
book-ali-hazelwood-love-theoretically.Jack Smith: An experimental physicist with considerable influence over Elsie's career. He is unusually good at spotting the moment she starts performing for somebody.
book-ali-hazelwood-love-theoretically.Greg Smith: Jack's brother hires Elsie to pose as his girlfriend. His family's interest in the relationship threatens a carefully negotiated arrangement.
book-ali-hazelwood-love-theoretically.Cece: Elsie's roommate and confidante knows the less polished version of a woman who adapts herself to almost everyone she meets.
book-ali-hazelwood-love-theoretically.Christophe Laurendeau: Elsie's academic mentor holds strong views about the rivalry between theoretical and experimental physics. His approval has shaped her understanding of her own career.

book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Jon Snow: Raised as Ned Stark's bastard, Jon knows the household intimately while remaining conscious of his place at its edge. The Night's Watch offers a different brotherhood.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Daenerys Targaryen: Ruling Meereen forces Daenerys to hear petitions about hunger, marriage, trade and the damage dragons do. Conquering a city gave her little preparation for the daily work.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Tyrion Lannister: A wealthy lord's son with dwarfism has learned to enter a room anticipating the joke. Books, money and a precise insult are among his defences.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Theon Greyjoy: Balon Greyjoy's son grew up as Ned Stark's ward and hostage. Returning to the Iron Islands means finding out whether his own family considers him one of them.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Davos Seaworth: A former smuggler raised to knighthood by Stannis. Gratitude makes him loyal enough to give his king advice nobody more polished dares to offer.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Bran Stark: A boy who loves climbing the walls of Winterfell and imagining himself a knight. His connection to his direwolf grows harder to explain.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Barristan Selmy: An aging knight with a lifetime of celebrated service. Serving Daenerys forces him to weigh the worth of a vow against the character of the ruler it protects.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Quentyn Martell: Doran Martell's dutiful son journeys far from Dorne on a dynastic errand. He is painfully conscious of falling short of the romantic idea of a prince.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Jon Connington: An exiled former lord carrying grief for a Targaryen prince. A secretive guardianship gives him another opportunity to prove his loyalty.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Asha Greyjoy: Balon Greyjoy's seafaring daughter commands a ship and has earned the loyalty of its crew. The succession tests whether the islands will accept that authority ashore.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Victarion Greyjoy: A formidable Iron Fleet commander most comfortable when a problem can be solved by force. His brothers' religious and political ambitions give him less certain footing.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Stannis Baratheon: Robert's brother believes the succession is a matter of law. He remembers debts and slights with extraordinary precision and finds being liked a poor substitute for being right.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Ramsay Bolton: Roose Bolton's son uses terror to make captives dependent on his approval. He demands every sign of legitimacy while revelling in the power of private cruelty.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Roose Bolton: A northern lord whose quiet voice makes an audience lean closer. He gives little away while calculating which alliance will best preserve his house.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Melisandre: A priestess of the Lord of Light who interprets visions in flame. Her certainty offers Stannis a kind of recognition his countrymen have withheld.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Arya Stark: A lord's daughter who would rather learn swordplay than needlework. She pays more attention to servants, animals and escapes than her elders realize.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Cersei Lannister: The queen guards her children and her position with equal ferocity. A lifetime of watching her twin receive freedoms denied to her feeds her political ambition.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Jorah Mormont: An exiled Westerosi knight familiar with Dothraki custom. Serving the young Targaryens offers him purpose, though his attachments and interests do not always align.
book-george-r-r-martin-a-dance-with-drag.Young Griff: A blue-haired youth travelling under an assumed identity has received an education fit for command. His guardians have made extraordinary plans for his future.

book-liane-moriarty-the-husbands-secret.Cecilia Fitzpatrick: An exceptionally organized mother and Tupperware seller finds a letter her husband intended her to read after his death. He is still very much alive.
book-liane-moriarty-the-husbands-secret.Tess: A woman returning to her mother's home with her son after a betrayal. An old acquaintance offers relief from the life she has temporarily left behind.
book-liane-moriarty-the-husbands-secret.Rachel Crowley: A school secretary still grieving her murdered daughter. Familiar faces around the school keep old affections and old suspicions painfully present.
book-liane-moriarty-the-husbands-secret.John-Paul Fitzpatrick: Cecilia's husband has managed his family life around something he put in writing years ago. He is far less composed when the letter reappears.
book-liane-moriarty-the-husbands-secret.Connor Whitby: A PE teacher with personal ties to both Tess and Rachel's daughter. Other people's recollections of his youth follow him through the school gates.

book-stephen-king-pet-sematary.Louis Creed: A physician who moves his family to rural Maine. Medical knowledge has given him a language for death, but little preparation for unbearable grief.
book-stephen-king-pet-sematary.Rachel Creed: Louis's wife has carried a childhood encounter with death for years. Her need to shield her children can make honest conversation painfully difficult.
book-stephen-king-pet-sematary.Jud Crandall: The elderly neighbour across the road is generous with local knowledge. One piece of advice comes with a history he struggles to explain.
book-stephen-king-pet-sematary.Ellie Creed: The Creeds' young daughter asks direct questions about what happens when pets and people die. Adults' evasions do little to reassure her.
book-stephen-king-pet-sematary.Gage Creed: Louis and Rachel's toddler delights in movement and in the people around him. That ordinary joy makes the busy road especially ominous.
book-stephen-king-pet-sematary.Victor Pascow: A badly injured student brought to Louis's clinic. His appearances thereafter blur the line between a physician's guilt and a warning.

book-julia-quinn-the-duke-and-i.Daphne Bridgerton: The eldest Bridgerton daughter wants a loving marriage but is usually treated as a friend. A pretend courtship offers her a chance to change the conversation.
book-julia-quinn-the-duke-and-i.Simon Basset: The new Duke of Hastings would prefer to avoid both marriage and inquiries about his childhood. Rehearsing a courtship with Daphne tests both resolutions.
book-julia-quinn-the-duke-and-i.Anthony Bridgerton: The eldest Bridgerton brother takes family duty seriously and often rather loudly. His confidence about other people's marriages exceeds his insight into his own feelings.
book-julia-quinn-the-duke-and-i.Violet Bridgerton: The widowed Bridgerton matriarch knows how to manage a ballroom. Beneath the matchmaking is a wish for her children to experience the happy marriage she remembers.
book-julia-quinn-the-duke-and-i.Colin Bridgerton: Daphne's brother moves through society with an easy grin. His sense of humour is particularly well exercised by the romantic predicaments of his siblings.

book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.Jing-mei Woo: A daughter asked to take her late mother's seat at the mah-jong table. She must piece together a history she spent years resisting.
book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.Suyuan Woo: Jing-mei's mother founded the Joy Luck Club and invested enormous hope in her daughter. Her faith in possibility carries memories of wartime separation.
book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.Lindo Jong: A mother who learned early how to outmanoeuvre an arranged marriage. Her daughter recognizes the same strategic intelligence across a chessboard.
book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.Waverly Jong: A childhood chess prodigy who knows how to anticipate an opponent. She finds it considerably harder to interpret a look from her mother.
book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.An-mei Hsu: Rose's mother remembers what female silence cost in her own family. She wants her daughter to find a voice before others decide her future.
book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.Rose Hsu Jordan: A daughter whose troubled marriage has exposed the limits of letting another person make every choice. Her mother's advice returns at inconvenient moments.
book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.Ying-ying St. Clair: Lena's mother carries a submerged history of loss from China. She sees her daughter's marriage with a clarity she struggles to put into English.
book-amy-tan-the-joy-luck-club.Lena St. Clair: A woman who keeps meticulous accounts with her husband in the name of fairness. Her mother's visit makes their arithmetic look less neutral.

book-stephen-king-11-22-63.Jake Epping: A Maine English teacher with access to the past. Living undercover tests whether he can witness an injustice without trying to change it.
book-stephen-king-11-22-63.Sadie Dunhill: A Texas school librarian whose warmth and forthrightness make Jake's borrowed life feel real. She has her own reasons to be wary of secrets.
book-stephen-king-11-22-63.Al Templeton: A diner owner who knows exactly what is unusual about his pantry. Failing health makes him eager to entrust his unfinished work to Jake.
book-stephen-king-11-22-63.Lee Harvey Oswald: A volatile young man under Jake's close observation. The difficulty is judging what his ordinary domestic movements might mean for a future assassination.
book-stephen-king-11-22-63.Harry Dunning: An adult student whose account of a childhood tragedy stays with Jake. His quiet trust gives time travel a personal stake.

book-robert-louis-stevenson-strange-case.Henry Jekyll / Edward Hyde: Jekyll is a well-regarded physician who believes he can separate the conflicting parts of his nature. His practiced courtesy and Hyde’s unnerving physical ease give one performer two distinct ways of entering a room.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-strange-case.Gabriel John Utterson: A reserved lawyer loyal to old friends even when their affairs become disreputable. An extraordinary will gives his discretion a dangerous object.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-strange-case.Hastie Lanyon: A doctor and old friend of Jekyll's who rejects his speculative science. Professional scepticism offers little protection against an experience he cannot explain.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-strange-case.Richard Enfield: Utterson's relative and walking companion tells an unsettling story about a door. His instinct afterward is to avoid asking questions about a gentleman's affairs.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-strange-case.Mr. Poole: Jekyll's longtime butler knows his employer's routines, voice and footsteps. A disturbance in the laboratory finally sends him for outside help.

book-ali-hazelwood-love-on-the-brain.Bee Königswasser: A neuroscientist who takes Marie Curie as a personal touchstone. Her dream NASA assignment has one apparent flaw, an engineer she is convinced despises her.
book-ali-hazelwood-love-on-the-brain.Levi Ward: An engineer co-leading Bee's project whose size and reserve make him easy to misread. When the work is threatened, he proves attentive to unusually small details.
book-ali-hazelwood-love-on-the-brain.Rocío Cortoreal: Bee's research assistant is a scientist with a goth wardrobe and a taste for morbid observations. Her deadpan delivery makes enthusiasm easy to miss.
book-ali-hazelwood-love-on-the-brain.Guy Kowalsky: A friendly astronaut working on the helmet project while grounded. His welcome helps Bee find her feet among the NASA engineers.

book-leigh-bardugo-siege-and-storm.Alina Starkov: An orphan and army mapmaker whose power to summon light makes her suddenly indispensable. She is still learning what to do when a whole room looks at her.
book-leigh-bardugo-siege-and-storm.Malyen Oretsev: Alina's childhood friend is an exceptionally gifted army tracker. In the field he notices the smallest change in the landscape, even when he misses one in her.
book-leigh-bardugo-siege-and-storm.The Darkling: The shadow-summoning commander of Ravka's Grisha speaks about their persecution with intimate conviction. He knows exactly how it feels to be the only one of your kind.
book-leigh-bardugo-siege-and-storm.Nikolai Lantsov: A younger prince with a sailor's ingenuity and a politician's ear. He can talk through a crisis while already taking apart the machine that caused it.
book-leigh-bardugo-siege-and-storm.Tolya Yul-Bataar: A Heartrender with the build of a fighter and a love of epic verse. He and his twin Tamar make an exceptionally steady pair under fire.
book-leigh-bardugo-siege-and-storm.Tamar Kir-Bataar: A Heartrender and fighter who favours axes. She works in close concert with her twin Tolya and has a dry answer ready for his poetry.

book-lauren-roberts-reckless.Paedyn Gray: A powerless pickpocket who passes as psychic by reading people's smallest tells. Saving the wrong stranger puts her powers of observation on public trial.
book-lauren-roberts-reckless.Kai Azer: A prince trained to enforce his father's laws. He can borrow the powers of Elites nearby, but Paedyn's nerve interests him more than any display of magic.
book-lauren-roberts-reckless.Kitt Azer: Ilya's heir is accustomed to being the more approachable brother. Kindness comes easily until it puts him at odds with the crown he expects to wear.
book-lauren-roberts-reckless.Lenny: A quick-moving Resistance member who calls Paedyn Princess. His jokes express the sort of loyalty that survives a dangerous reunion.

book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Ben Mears: A writer returning to the Maine town he knew as a boy. The old Marsten house still has a hold on his imagination.
book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Susan Norton: A young local woman drawn to Ben and to the possibility of a life beyond the town her mother has planned for her.
book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Mark Petrie: A boy fascinated by horror stories whose knowledge of their rules proves unexpectedly practical. He can act decisively when adults hesitate.
book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Kurt Barlow: An ancient vampire moving into a small town where neighbours know one another's secrets but hesitate to interfere.
book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Richard Straker: Barlow's impeccably civil human representative handles the antiques shop, the property arrangements and the visitors his employer would prefer to receive privately.
book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Father Donald Callahan: A parish priest weary of small compromises who longs to confront unmistakable evil. The prospect becomes harder when it presents itself in person.
book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Matt Burke: A well-read high-school teacher whose home becomes a place to compare alarming observations. His intellectual curiosity makes him surprisingly receptive to impossible evidence.
book-stephen-king-salems-lot.Jimmy Cody: A physician who approaches the town's illnesses as medical puzzles. Once ordinary explanations fail, he still insists on looking closely.

book-herman-melville-moby-dick.Ishmael: A restless schoolmaster goes whaling and narrates everything from shipboard friendships to whale anatomy. Curiosity repeatedly draws him outside the assumptions he brought aboard.
book-herman-melville-moby-dick.Captain Ahab: The Pequod's one-legged captain has turned a commercial voyage into a personal pursuit. He understands how to make his obsession feel like a crew's common purpose.
book-herman-melville-moby-dick.Queequeg: An accomplished harpooner far from his island home befriends Ishmael before they sail. His calm generosity revises the narrator's idea of who counts as civilized.
book-herman-melville-moby-dick.Starbuck: The first mate is a conscientious Quaker who understands the difference between a dangerous profession and a suicidal command. Opposing his captain remains another matter.
book-herman-melville-moby-dick.Stubb: The second mate keeps a pipe and a joke ready even in danger. Humour helps him make alarming orders seem part of a day's work.
book-herman-melville-moby-dick.Pip: The ship's young Black cabin boy entertains the crew with his tambourine. His vulnerability becomes impossible to ignore once he is sent out in a whaleboat.
book-herman-melville-moby-dick.Fedallah: A Parsee harpooner with a mysterious hold on Ahab. His prophecies invite exactly the interpretation the captain most wants to hear.

book-jennifer-l-armentrout-a-kingdom-of-.Penellaphe Balfour (Poppy): Among people who tell a different history of her kingdom, Poppy wants answers about her own abilities. Attraction to Casteel makes trust more difficult to judge.
book-jennifer-l-armentrout-a-kingdom-of-.Casteel Da’Neer (Hawke): Casteel has a missing brother, a country's expectations and a proposed marriage to consider. The man Poppy knew as Hawke must now answer her questions as a prince.
book-jennifer-l-armentrout-a-kingdom-of-.Kieran Contou: A dryly observant wolven warrior close to Hawke. He answers Poppy's endless questions with a mixture of patience, candour and amusement.
book-jennifer-l-armentrout-a-kingdom-of-.Alastir Davenwell: A veteran wolven adviser with close ties to the royal family. He presents his knowledge of Atlantian custom as help to a newcomer.
book-jennifer-l-armentrout-a-kingdom-of-.Delano: A pale-haired wolven loyal to Casteel who treats Poppy with an openness that stands out in her unfamiliar surroundings.

book-holly-jackson-as-good-as-dead.Pippa Fitz-Amobi: Pip is preparing for university while anonymous threats move closer to home. Testing her own suspicions proves much harder than investigating another person's testimony.
book-holly-jackson-as-good-as-dead.Ravi Singh: The accused boy's younger brother has lived for years with his town's verdict. He brings personal knowledge and a dry wit to Pip's investigation.
book-holly-jackson-as-good-as-dead.Max Hastings: A well-connected young man accustomed to being given the benefit of the doubt. His public confidence has become a particular source of fury for Pip.
book-holly-jackson-as-good-as-dead.Jason Bell: Andie Bell's father has lived for years under the scrutiny that followed his daughter's disappearance. His authority at home casts a long shadow.
book-holly-jackson-as-good-as-dead.Cara Ward: Pip's close friend is one of her strongest links to ordinary school life. The case comes dangerously close to the people Cara trusts most.

book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Digory Kirke: A London boy frightened of losing his mother explores the attics with Polly. His curiosity and his longing for a cure make him vulnerable to very different temptations.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Polly Plummer: A sensible London girl whose attic explorations bring her a friend and an alarming experiment. She is less impressed than Digory by displays of imperial grandeur.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Jadis (the White Witch): The last queen of Charn awakens in a ruined world she once ruled. Stripped of familiar powers, she still expects every person she meets to obey.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Aslan: A great lion whose name arouses a different feeling in each child. His authority leaves room for tenderness, play and acts nobody else understands in advance.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Andrew Ketterley: Digory's uncle considers himself a magician of exceptional destiny. He prefers to send children or guinea pigs on the experiments that might prove it.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Fledge: Once a London cab horse called Strawberry, he encounters a new world where he can speak and where his body gains extraordinary possibilities.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Frank: A London cabdriver finds himself among the first witnesses to Narnia's creation. A habit of treating his horse kindly says much about how he might govern.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Helen: Frank's wife comes from an ordinary working household. She steps into an unfamiliar country whose idea of fitness to rule has little to do with rank.
book-c-s-lewis-the-magicians-nephew.Mabel Kirke: Digory's gravely ill mother is the person he most wants to help. His longing to bring her relief drives a particularly difficult choice.

book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Rand al'Thor: A shepherd from the Two Rivers encounters signs that his family history is more complicated than he knew. Stubborn loyalty repeatedly outweighs his instinct to flee.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Moiraine Damodred: An Aes Sedai arrives in a secluded village with urgent business she only partly explains. Her composure makes even helpful interventions feel calculated.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Mat Cauthon: A village prankster whose quick hands and quicker curiosity survive contact with danger. He especially dislikes being told that an object is off limits.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Perrin Aybara: A blacksmith's apprentice accustomed to measuring his strength around others. He prefers to think before acting and takes violence very personally.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Egwene al'Vere: An innkeeper's daughter who sees a future on the road where others see only danger. Learning what she might become matters to her on its own terms.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Nynaeve al'Meara: The young Wisdom of the village tracks the party to protect her people. Competence came before formal authority for her, and challenges to either can draw sparks.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Lan Mandragoran: Moiraine's Warder speaks sparingly and pays close attention to terrain, weapons and people. His harsh lessons are a practical expression of concern.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Thom Merrilin: A travelling gleeman whose patches, juggling and songs conceal a shrewd understanding of courts. He knows when an audience is becoming a threat.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Loial: A young Ogier who loves books, trees and careful explanations. Humans have a habit of making three decisions before he has finished the first qualification.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Tam al'Thor: Rand's father is an unassuming farmer who handles a sword with inexplicable skill. A feverish remark from him unsettles Rand's sense of home.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Padan Fain: A peddler whose visits once meant news from outside the valley. His interest in a few village youths proves far more persistent than ordinary trade.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Ishamael: A powerful servant of the Shadow associated with the name Ba'alzamon. Dreams offer him a place to menace and question people far beyond his physical reach.
book-robert-jordan-the-eye-of-the-world.Elyas Machera: A wilderness traveller who communicates with wolves. He offers Perrin a possible explanation for experiences the young blacksmith has hardly admitted to himself.

book-leigh-bardugo-ruin-and-rising.Alina Starkov: An orphan and army mapmaker whose power to summon light makes her suddenly indispensable. She is still learning what to do when a whole room looks at her.
book-leigh-bardugo-ruin-and-rising.Malyen Oretsev: Alina's childhood friend is an exceptionally gifted army tracker. In the field he notices the smallest change in the landscape, even when he misses one in her.
book-leigh-bardugo-ruin-and-rising.The Darkling: The shadow-summoning commander of Ravka's Grisha speaks about their persecution with intimate conviction. He knows exactly how it feels to be the only one of your kind.
book-leigh-bardugo-ruin-and-rising.Nikolai Lantsov: A younger prince with a sailor's ingenuity and a politician's ear. He can talk through a crisis while already taking apart the machine that caused it.
book-leigh-bardugo-ruin-and-rising.Baghra: A formidable Grisha teacher who meets Alina's uncertainty with a stick and a cutting remark. She takes the consequences of power very seriously.
book-leigh-bardugo-ruin-and-rising.Genya Safin: A Grisha Tailor who can alter a person's appearance. Serving the queen has taught her to offer kindness in a palace that treats beauty as currency.
book-leigh-bardugo-ruin-and-rising.The Apparat: The king's spiritual adviser smells an opportunity in the country's devotion to its Sun Summoner. He speaks softly enough to make Alina lean in.

book-thomas-harris-the-silence-of-the-la.Clarice Starling: An FBI trainee interviews a prisoner who demands personal truths in return for clues. Her careful diction carries the trace of a childhood she rarely discusses.
book-thomas-harris-the-silence-of-the-la.Hannibal Lecter: An imprisoned psychiatrist with exquisite manners, an exact memory and an appetite for psychological intimacy. He sets the terms of a conversation from behind bars.
book-thomas-harris-the-silence-of-the-la.Jame Gumb: A serial murderer known to investigators as Buffalo Bill. In private he is methodical about the elaborate project for which he selects his victims.
book-thomas-harris-the-silence-of-the-la.Jack Crawford: The FBI investigator directing the case sends a promising trainee to interview Lecter. His professional control is under strain at home as well.
book-thomas-harris-the-silence-of-the-la.Catherine Martin: A senator's daughter held captive by the killer. She studies the few things within reach and looks for any decision that can still be hers.
book-thomas-harris-the-silence-of-the-la.Frederick Chilton: The administrator overseeing Lecter's confinement craves recognition for managing a famous patient. He is particularly susceptible to the prospect of publicity.
book-thomas-harris-the-silence-of-the-la.Ardelia Mapp: Clarice's fellow trainee and roommate is an excellent sounding board. She spots the assumption that sometimes survives even a very careful reading.

book-rachel-gillig-two-twisted-crowns.Elm Rowan: The king's younger son uses irreverence to survive his brother's court. He knows from experience what a Providence Card can make someone do.
book-rachel-gillig-two-twisted-crowns.Ione Hawthorn: Elspeth's cousin is drawn into a royal betrothal through the Maiden Card. Its promise of perfect beauty comes with a frightening change in how she feels.
book-rachel-gillig-two-twisted-crowns.Elspeth Spindle: A young woman sharing her mind with a monster. She has spent years hiding both the infection that marked her and the voice that answers her thoughts.
book-rachel-gillig-two-twisted-crowns.Ravyn Yew: The captain of the king's Destriers outwardly serves the law that threatens people like Elspeth. His private search for Providence Cards requires an unlikely ally.
book-rachel-gillig-two-twisted-crowns.The Nightmare: An ancient presence in Elspeth's mind, by turns protector, storyteller and unsettling guest. It has its own ideas about the price of lending her strength.
book-rachel-gillig-two-twisted-crowns.The Spirit of the Wood: The power inhabiting the forest beyond the kingdom's roads. Travellers seeking aid must reckon with a presence whose bargains carry very literal costs.

book-ian-mcewan-atonement.Briony Tallis: A thirteen-year-old aspiring playwright sees an encounter she cannot interpret. Her ability to turn a fragment into a coherent story is precisely the danger.
book-ian-mcewan-atonement.Cecilia Tallis: Briony's older sister has returned from university to a household that feels too small. An argument with Robbie reveals feelings neither has yet named.
book-ian-mcewan-atonement.Robbie Turner: The housekeeper's son has been educated alongside the Tallises. His apparent ease in their world can vanish the instant somebody invokes his status.
book-ian-mcewan-atonement.Lola Quincey: Briony's visiting cousin performs worldly sophistication while her parents' marriage collapses. The younger girl's fascination with her makes an unreliable lens.
book-ian-mcewan-atonement.Paul Marshall: A wealthy chocolate manufacturer visiting the Tallis estate. Money has made him comfortable occupying space and receiving the benefit of the doubt.
book-ian-mcewan-atonement.Emily Tallis: The Tallis children's mother retreats from migraines to a darkened room. She believes she understands her household through the sounds beyond her door.

book-r-f-kuang-babel.Robin Swift: A Cantonese boy raised in England becomes an Oxford translation scholar. He loves the work even as he learns what Britain's imperial economy asks it to sustain.
book-r-f-kuang-babel.Ramy Mirza: A Muslim student from Calcutta whose wit makes him Robin's closest friend. He recognizes the racial bargain beneath Oxford's hospitality faster than Robin does.
book-r-f-kuang-babel.Victoire Desgraves: A Haitian scholar navigating Oxford as a Black woman. Her command of languages far exceeds the institution's willingness to recognize her on equal terms.
book-r-f-kuang-babel.Letty Price: A white Englishwoman determined to claim a scholar's place denied to women. Other barriers facing her cohort are considerably harder for her to see.
book-r-f-kuang-babel.Richard Lovell: The formidable professor who brings Robin to England expects obedience in exchange for education. He values the boy's languages as a resource for Babel.
book-r-f-kuang-babel.Griffin Lovell: A secretive figure with an uncanny resemblance to Robin offers him a different understanding of what translation and silver make possible.

book-stephanie-garber-the-ballad-of-neve.Evangeline Fox: A curiosity-shop owner's daughter who believes in true love strongly enough to bargain with a Fate. She has a harder time spotting the loopholes.
book-stephanie-garber-the-ballad-of-neve.Jacks: The Prince of Hearts has a taste for apples and a reputation for deadly kisses. He offers help on terms that become clearer after the bargain.
book-stephanie-garber-the-ballad-of-neve.Apollo Acadian: A northern prince whose good looks and position make him the centre of a royal marriage spectacle. His attention changes Evangeline's prospects overnight.
book-stephanie-garber-the-ballad-of-neve.Chaos: A dangerous figure in a helmet with a locked mouthpiece. His dealings with Jacks suggest a history far older than Evangeline's understanding of the North.
book-stephanie-garber-the-ballad-of-neve.LaLa: A Fate known as the Unwed Bride who takes a personal interest in Evangeline. She knows what it is to have a story assigned to you.

book-robert-louis-stevenson-treasure-isl.Jim Hawkins: An innkeeper's son finds a map and sails with men whose loyalties he imperfectly understands. Curiosity keeps getting him into positions where courage is necessary.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-treasure-isl.Long John Silver: A one-legged ship's cook can make a frightened boy feel like a trusted partner. His warmth makes it especially difficult for Jim to judge his intentions.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-treasure-isl.Doctor Livesey: A physician and magistrate who keeps his head among quarrelling adventurers. His professional duty extends even to men who have threatened him.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-treasure-isl.Captain Smollett: The Hispaniola's captain dislikes a voyage whose secrets seem universally known. His insistence on discipline looks considerably wiser once the danger is visible.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-treasure-isl.Squire Trelawney: A wealthy enthusiast finances the expedition and delights in outfitting a ship. Keeping the purpose of the voyage to himself proves much less enjoyable.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-treasure-isl.Ben Gunn: A marooned sailor has spent years alone on the island. Conversation veers between vital intelligence and an entirely understandable longing for cheese.
book-robert-louis-stevenson-treasure-isl.Billy Bones: An old seaman occupying Jim's family inn watches the coast for former shipmates. A sea chest, a song and a taste for rum keep him company.

book-liu-cixin-the-three-body-problem.Ye Wenjie: An astrophysicist whose experience of political violence informs her work at an isolated radio facility. Listening for a signal becomes a deeply personal act.
book-liu-cixin-the-three-body-problem.Wang Miao: A nanomaterials researcher sees a baffling countdown intrude on his life. His investigation takes him from laboratory instruments into a strange virtual civilization.
book-liu-cixin-the-three-body-problem.Shi Qiang: A blunt police detective, nicknamed Da Shi, trusts an inconsistency in a person's behaviour more readily than an elegant scientific explanation.
book-liu-cixin-the-three-body-problem.Yang Dong: A theoretical physicist and Ye Wenjie's daughter. A crisis over the reliability of physical laws gives her scientific questions an intensely personal urgency.
book-liu-cixin-the-three-body-problem.Mike Evans: An environmentalist from a wealthy family who takes the destruction of other species personally. He has the resources to act on unusually sweeping convictions.
book-liu-cixin-the-three-body-problem.Shen Yufei: A physicist connected to the Frontiers of Science group. Her unnerving certainty sends Wang looking beyond the explanations his own discipline can offer.

book-agatha-christie-the-mysterious-affa.Hercule Poirot: A Belgian refugee living near Styles brings professional experience and an exact eye for household arrangements to his friend Hastings's first account of a mystery.
book-agatha-christie-the-mysterious-affa.Arthur Hastings: A wounded British officer recuperating at Styles. His admiration for Poirot is genuine, although his ready-made explanations make the detective's work harder.
book-agatha-christie-the-mysterious-affa.Emily Inglethorp: The wealthy mistress of Styles Court controls the family purse. Her late marriage has given everyone at home a new reason to watch her decisions.
book-agatha-christie-the-mysterious-affa.Alfred Inglethorp: Emily's much younger husband attracts suspicion through his manner, his beard and his sudden position in a household that resents him.
book-agatha-christie-the-mysterious-affa.Evelyn Howard: Emily's blunt companion distrusts Alfred and considers it her duty to say so, however unwelcome her warnings become.
book-agatha-christie-the-mysterious-affa.John Cavendish: Emily's stepson plays host at Styles while depending financially on a woman who can change his prospects with a signature.
book-agatha-christie-the-mysterious-affa.Mary Cavendish: John's wife impresses Hastings with her poise. She is considerably harder to read than a first meeting on an English country estate suggests.

book-ali-hazelwood-deep-end.Scarlett Vandermeer: A Stanford platform diver working toward medical school and a return from injury. She can describe the mechanics of a dive she still cannot bring herself to attempt.
book-ali-hazelwood-deep-end.Lukas Blomqvist: A championship swimmer who treats training with extraordinary discipline. Around Scarlett, his directness makes difficult conversations about desire surprisingly possible.
book-ali-hazelwood-deep-end.Penelope Ross: Scarlett's teammate and close friend, known as Pen. Her history with Lukas makes honesty among the three athletes unusually consequential.

book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Lucy Pevensie: Aboard the Dawn Treader, Lucy is an experienced visitor to Narnia. A magician's book tests the difference between wanting to know the truth and wanting to overhear a friend.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Edmund Pevensie: A younger brother who resents being laughed at. The promise of sweets, importance and an audience willing to hear his grievances proves dangerously attractive.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Eustace Scrubb: The Pevensies' cousin boards the ship with a talent for complaint and a firm conviction that books with dragons are useless.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Caspian X: The young king sails east in search of seven missing lords. His duties as monarch do not always agree with his desire to see what lies beyond the horizon.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Reepicheep: A small talking mouse with a swordsman's manners and an adventurer's appetite. He takes insults seriously and longs above everything to reach the utter East.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Aslan: A great lion whose name arouses a different feeling in each child. His authority leaves room for tenderness, play and acts nobody else understands in advance.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Drinian: Captain of the Dawn Treader, responsible for the ship while a king pursues a quest. He keeps weather, soundings and crew safety very much in mind.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Coriakin: A magician governing a troublesome island people. Meeting him gives Lucy a chance to reconsider what she has heard from his frightened subjects.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Ramandu: A retired star living beside a mysterious table near the world's edge. His existence stretches the travellers' understanding of what a star can be.
book-c-s-lewis-the-voyage-of-the-dawn-tr.Ramandu's daughter: Ramandu's daughter welcomes the voyagers to the island and explains the enchantment surrounding the sleepers. Her meeting with Caspian gives the quest a more personal dimension.

book-toni-morrison-beloved.Sethe: A woman who escaped slavery is raising her daughter in a haunted Ohio house. Her fierce idea of a mother's duty makes the past intensely present.
book-toni-morrison-beloved.Denver: Sethe's daughter grew up isolated by the house and its history. A stranger's arrival offers her the possibility of being indispensable to someone.
book-toni-morrison-beloved.Beloved: A mysterious young woman appears near Sethe's home with an extraordinary thirst for stories and attention. Her need changes the balance of the household.
book-toni-morrison-beloved.Paul D: A survivor of Sweet Home arrives hoping to make a life with Sethe. He has spent years keeping some memories beyond the reach of speech.
book-toni-morrison-beloved.Baby Suggs: Sethe's mother-in-law gathers formerly enslaved neighbours to celebrate bodies they can finally claim as their own. Her influence persists in an emptied house.
book-toni-morrison-beloved.Stamp Paid: A formerly enslaved man who helps people cross the river to freedom. His intimate knowledge of the community brings obligations he cannot easily set down.

book-julia-quinn-the-viscount-who-loved-.Anthony Bridgerton: A viscount selecting a wife on supposedly practical grounds reckons without her sister Kate. His neat rules about love conceal a very personal terror of loss.
book-julia-quinn-the-viscount-who-loved-.Kate Sheffield: Edwina's protective older half-sister has firm opinions about unsuitable husbands. Anthony's decision to court Edwina gives Kate ample opportunity to express them.
book-julia-quinn-the-viscount-who-loved-.Edwina Sheffield: A much-admired debutante who values her sister's judgment. Being the object of everyone's plans has not deprived her of preferences of her own.
book-julia-quinn-the-viscount-who-loved-.Mary Sheffield: Mother to Edwina and stepmother to Kate, Mary treats both daughters as her own. Her kindness gives the sisters a secure base in a competitive marriage season.
book-julia-quinn-the-viscount-who-loved-.Violet Bridgerton: The widowed Bridgerton matriarch knows how to manage a ballroom. Beneath the matchmaking is a wish for her children to experience the happy marriage she remembers.
book-julia-quinn-the-viscount-who-loved-.Colin Bridgerton: Daphne's brother moves through society with an easy grin. His sense of humour is particularly well exercised by the romantic predicaments of his siblings.
